items.step: Define handoff identity and import primitives
Implement environment acceptance and BindingPlan
Integrate Environment with Machine dispatch
Implement RunState and RunImage encode/decode/validate
Implement Handoff preflight, resume, replay, verify, and branch workflows
Add handoff examples, docs, and build wiring
Run fixed-point closure, full Zig proof bundle, and ship PR
step=core_model; owner=implementation; success_criteria=version constants, supervision structs, fingerprint helpers, and isolated fingerprint/exclusion tests compile and pass.
step=policy_accounting; owner=implementation; success_criteria=policy presets, budgets, per-port budgets, cost model, port rules, ledger, and checks enforce deterministic limits.
step=membrane; owner=implementation; success_criteria=single `Supervisor`/`PolicyMembrane` path denies before adapter calls, transcript appends, branch/checkpoint, and handoff side effects.
step=machine_integration; owner=implementation; success_criteria=optional permit, strict permit enforcement, receipt availability, no-permit compatibility.
step=timeline_environment_handoff; owner=implementation; success_criteria=supervision timeline events, Environment blockers, receiver-issued handoff permit APIs, prior receipt inspection.
step=branch_checkpoint_handoff_budgets; owner=implementation; success_criteria=max counts/depth/cost/inherit/new-permit policies tested.
step=examples_docs_build; owner=implementation; success_criteria=five new examples, run steps, README update, `docs/supervision.md`, check step coverage.
step=proof_closeout; owner=implementation; success_criteria=run required proof commands, inspect diff, report any blockers with exact failing command.

proof.command: zig build check --summary all; zig build test --summary all; filtered supervision tests; examples; lint
proof.evidence_ref: check: 66/66 steps succeeded, 81/81 tests passed; test: 81/81; all requested new/regression examples passed; all requested supervision filters passed; lint passed

items.step: step=admission_package_foundation; owner=implementation; success_criteria=version constants, `TransferPackage`, `PackageManifest`, encode/decode/validate, deterministic fingerprints, validation limits, malformed/oversized rejection, and package/manifest tests pass.

step=module_registry_gateway; owner=implementation; success_criteria=`ModuleRef`, `ModuleGateway`, `TargetRegistry`, `TargetMatch`, `ExportSummary`, module-derived import summaries, local target matching, inspect-only full module support, and registry/gateway/match tests pass.

step=admission_decision_layer; owner=implementation; success_criteria=`AdmissionMode`, `AdmissionPolicy`, `AdmissionRequest`, `AdmissionReport`, `AdmissionReceipt`, deterministic blockers/warnings/fingerprints, and policy/report/receipt tests pass.

step=execution_integration; owner=implementation; success_criteria=`Admitter` produces `AdmittedRun` only for accepted executable modes; RunImage, Handoff, Supervision, and Timeline carry optional module/admission links while old images/tests remain compatible.

step=examples_docs_build; owner=implementation; success_criteria=five admission examples, build run steps, README update, `docs/admission.md`, and check-step wiring compile and demonstrate reference, full-module inspect, parked handoff, replay/verify, and agent transfer scenarios.

step=fixed_point_review; owner=verification; success_criteria=no duplicate truth owner, no unretired scaffold, no unresolved material counterexample, and one-change challenge produces no further required code change.

step=proof_closeout_and_ship; owner=verification; success_criteria=all requested format, diff, build, check, example, filtered test, full test, and lint commands pass; `$st` projection is clean; PR is opened or updated with proof.

proof.command: zig version; zig fmt --check build.zig src examples test; git diff --check; zig build --summary all; zig build check --summary all; requested admission/regression examples; zig build test --summary all; requested filtered admission tests; zig build lint -- --max-warnings 0
proof.evidence_ref: zig 0.16.0; build 4/4 and 126/126 tests; check 81/81 and 126/126 tests; all requested examples/filters/lint passed
